ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of child care fraud cases to determine the extent of the problem and identify potential solutions.
questions: What is the total amount of money lost to child care fraud?
How can the child care industry be regulated to prevent fraud?
ideas.insight: This story idea is significant because it highlights the need for increased oversight and regulation in the child care industry. By following the money, we can determine the extent of the problem and identify potential solutions.

ideas.title: The Epstein Investigation: Uncovering the Truth
ideas.description: Investigate the Epstein investigation to determine the extent of his ties to U.S. Customs Officers and identify potential wrongdoing.
questions: What are the details of Epstein's ties to U.S. Customs Officers?
What potential wrongdoing was uncovered during the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story idea is significant because it highlights the need for transparency and accountability in high-profile investigations. By uncovering the truth, we can determine the extent of Epstein's wrongdoing and identify potential solutions.
